lines.zh: 我太小了，一道水流就能把我推走。
lines.en: I am so small that one current carries me away.

lines.zh: 我贴着沙面挪，怕被卷到上面去。
lines.en: I creep along the sand, afraid of being swept up.

lines.zh: 我一张一合地赶路，速度像蜗牛。
lines.en: I pulse my way along at a snail's pace.

lines.zh: 我从海葵触手里挤出去，扎得发痒。
lines.en: I squeeze out of the anemone's grasp, prickling all over.

lines.zh: 我漂过一枚贝壳，它比我大得多。
lines.en: I drift past a shell that is far bigger than me.

lines.zh: 我藏进石缝，再探出半个伞盖看路。
lines.en: I hide in a crack, then poke half my bell out to look.

lines.zh: 我顺着沉船木板的缝游，那里没有鱼。
lines.en: I swim the gaps between wreck planks, where no fish go.

lines.zh: 我一路躲着水母群，它们会撞散我。
lines.en: I dodge the jelly crowd; they would knock me apart.

lines.zh: 我追着一粒浮游生物，追了很远。
lines.en: I chase one speck of plankton much too far.

lines.zh: 我浮得很低，几乎擦着海草叶尖。
lines.en: I float low, almost brushing the tips of the seagrass.

lines.zh: 我绕着水草转圈，让水流绕开我。
lines.en: I circle the weeds so the current slides around me.

lines.zh: 我抬头看光，光离我还有好远。
lines.en: I look up at the light, still so far above me.

lines.zh: 我挪到暖一点的水层，身体才能松开。
lines.en: I move to warmer water, where my body can loosen.

lines.zh: 我越游越偏，下面的涌动推着我。
lines.en: I keep veering off; the swell below pushes me sideways.

lines.zh: 我在两块石头之间来回漂，找缝过去。
lines.en: I drift between two rocks, hunting a gap.

lines.zh: 我一收一放，慢慢升到水草上面。
lines.en: Pulse by pulse, I rise above the seagrass.

lines.zh: 我缩成一小团，像一粒会发光的沙。
lines.en: I curl into a speck, a grain of sand that glows.

lines.zh: 我挂在海草上，谁经过都看不见我。
lines.en: I hang on a blade of seagrass where nobody sees me.

lines.zh: 我安静地数气泡，一共七个。
lines.en: I quietly count the bubbles: seven of them.

lines.zh: 我尽量不发光，暗一点更安全。
lines.en: I try not to glow; darker is safer.

lines.zh: 我等着水流把我带到哪儿算哪儿。
lines.en: I wait for the current to take me wherever it likes.

lines.zh: 我憋着那点气，太小了，炸不响。
lines.en: I hold my little gas; I am too small to make a bang.

lines.zh: 我在贝壳口歇着，里头有回声。
lines.en: I rest in a shell's mouth, where sounds echo.

lines.zh: 我不敢动，上面有条大鱼在巡。
lines.en: I dare not move; a big fish patrols overhead.

lines.zh: 我把自己塞进珊瑚孔里，刚刚好。
lines.en: I tuck myself into a coral hole that fits exactly.

lines.zh: 我一点一点地亮，像在打瞌睡。
lines.en: I brighten by inches, as if dozing off.

lines.zh: 我听见远处有爆炸，缩得更小了。
lines.en: I hear an explosion far off and shrink even smaller.

lines.zh: 我等一只虾走过，好跟着它一段。
lines.en: I wait for a shrimp to pass so I can follow it.

lines.zh: 我的触须太短，碰不到任何东西。
lines.en: My tentacles are too short to reach anything at all.

lines.zh: 我就这么挂着，海水替我摇晃。
lines.en: I just hang there and let the sea rock me.

lines.zh: 我仰头看你，你像一座会走的塔。
lines.en: I look up at you; you are a walking tower.

lines.zh: 你的靴子落下来，沙子全飞了。
lines.en: Your boot comes down and the sand flies everywhere.

lines.zh: 我躲在你影子里，影子比礁石大。
lines.en: I hide in your shadow, which is bigger than the reef.

lines.zh: 我盯着你的手指，那里有食物味。
lines.en: I stare at your fingers; they smell of food.

lines.zh: 你弯腰的时候，我以为天塌了。
lines.en: When you bent down, I thought the sky had fallen.

lines.zh: 我努力亮了一下，想让你看见我。
lines.en: I glow as hard as I can, hoping you will notice me.

lines.zh: 你游得那么慢，我反而不怕了。
lines.en: You swim so slowly that I stop being afraid.

lines.zh: 我看见你身后拖着一串气泡。
lines.en: I see a string of bubbles trailing behind you.

lines.zh: 我在你护目镜上蹭了蹭，很滑。
lines.en: I brush your goggles; they are very slippery.

lines.zh: 你伸手过来，我立刻钻回缝里。
lines.en: Your hand comes near, and I dive back into the crack.

lines.zh: 好疼，我差点被拍散。
lines.en: That hurt; I nearly got scattered.

lines.zh: 我缩到最小，希望你别再打。
lines.en: I shrink as small as I can, hoping you will stop.

lines.zh: 我漏了一点光，很快就止住了。
lines.en: I leak a little light, and it stops soon.

lines.zh: 我那点气被震得乱窜。
lines.en: The little gas I have rattles around wildly.

lines.zh: 我躲进沙里，只留下一个印。
lines.en: I burrow into the sand and leave only a dent.

lines.zh: 疼得我方向都分不清了。
lines.en: It hurts enough that I lose all sense of direction.

lines.zh: 我太小，挨一下就非常严重。
lines.en: I am so small that one hit is very serious.

lines.zh: 我颤了很久才重新张开伞盖。
lines.en: I tremble a long while before reopening my bell.

lines.zh: 你要是再碰，我真的会炸。
lines.en: Touch me again and I truly will burst.

lines.zh: 我记住了你打我的那只手。
lines.en: I remember the hand that struck me.

lines.zh: 一小撮鱼食，我就什么都不想了。
lines.en: One pinch of fish feed and I stop thinking entirely.

lines.zh: 你晃瓶子，我的触须跟着晃。
lines.en: You shake the bottle, and my tentacles shake with it.

lines.zh: 那点碎屑比我的身体还大。
lines.en: That crumb is bigger than my whole body.

lines.zh: 我明知道是陷阱，还是往前凑。
lines.en: I know it is a trap, and I still lean in.

lines.zh: 我追着气泡跑，气泡里有点味道。
lines.en: I chase a bubble because it tastes of something.

lines.zh: 你手一沉，我就跟到你的掌心。
lines.en: Your hand dips, and I follow it to your palm.

lines.zh: 我太饿了，顾不上你另一只手。
lines.en: I am too hungry to watch your other hand.

lines.zh: 那光晃得我发晕，我就朝它去了。
lines.en: The light sways until I am dizzy, and I go to it.

lines.zh: 我绕着你撒下的东西转了三圈。
lines.en: I circle what you scattered three whole times.

lines.zh: 你别停手，一停我就清醒了。
lines.en: Do not stop; the moment you do, I come to my senses.

lines.zh: 你碰了我一下，我翻了个身。
lines.en: You touch me and I tumble over.

lines.zh: 我太轻，撞上去像撞到墙。
lines.en: I am so light that hitting you feels like hitting a wall.

lines.zh: 我的伞盖被压扁，又慢慢鼓回来。
lines.en: My bell squashes flat and slowly puffs back.

lines.zh: 别用脚踢，我会散成好几块。
lines.en: Do not kick me; I would scatter into pieces.

lines.zh: 这一撞把我推出了半米远。
lines.en: That bump shoves me half a meter away.

lines.zh: 我贴在你腿上，像一片湿的叶子。
lines.en: I cling to your leg like a wet leaf.

lines.zh: 我们碰上时，我听见自己嗡了一声。
lines.en: When we meet, I hear myself hum once.

lines.zh: 你退一步，我才敢重新张开。
lines.en: You step back, and only then do I reopen.

lines.zh: 我撞到你的桶，桶比我还硬。
lines.en: I bump your bucket; it is harder than I am.

lines.zh: 这一下不疼，只是有点晕。
lines.en: That did not hurt; it just left me dizzy.

lines.zh: 两个小东西贴在一起，像一颗露珠。
lines.en: Two small things press together like a dewdrop.

lines.zh: 它比我还小，我把它护在伞下。
lines.en: It is smaller than I am, so I shelter it under my bell.

lines.zh: 我们绕着彼此转，转得头晕。
lines.en: We circle each other until we are dizzy.

lines.zh: 我用触须碰它，它回碰了一下。
lines.en: I touch it with a tentacle, and it touches back once.

lines.zh: 我们一起躲进同一道石缝里。
lines.en: We hide together in the same stone crack.

lines.zh: 它的光比我的亮，我不介意。
lines.en: Its light is brighter than mine, and I do not mind.

lines.zh: 我们不吵，只并排悬着。
lines.en: We do not argue; we simply hang side by side.

lines.zh: 它游走了，我跟三步就停下。
lines.en: It swims off; I follow three beats, then stop.

lines.zh: 我们碰了一下，那是我最响的一次。
lines.en: We touched once, and it was my loudest moment.

lines.zh: 分开以后，我还记得它的方向。
lines.en: After we part, I still remember which way it went.

lines.zh: 你掉的东西落下来，砸在我头上。
lines.en: What you dropped falls and lands on my head.

lines.zh: 我试着抱住它，触须根本抱不拢。
lines.en: I try to hug it, but my tentacles cannot close around it.

lines.zh: 那枚碎片比我还重，我推不动。
lines.en: That shard weighs more than I do; I cannot budge it.

lines.zh: 我身上掉的那点凝胶，你捡走吧。
lines.en: Take the bit of gel that fell off me.

lines.zh: 我没有手，只能用伞盖顶着它走。
lines.en: I have no hands, so I push it with my bell.

lines.zh: 它沉下去了，我跟着沉了一段。
lines.en: It sinks, and I sink along with it for a while.

lines.zh: 你捡起来的时候，我有点舍不得。
lines.en: When you pick it up, I feel a small pang.

lines.zh: 那东西反光，我以为是吃的。
lines.en: It glints, and I mistake it for food.

lines.zh: 我把它藏在沙下，转头就忘了地方。
lines.en: I bury it in the sand and forget where at once.

lines.zh: 你拿走比我留着好，我守不住。
lines.en: Better you take it; I cannot guard anything.

lines.zh: 有东西靠近，我立刻缩到石缝口。
lines.en: Something approaches, and I dart to the crack's mouth.

lines.zh: 我听见咀嚼声，那不是我发出的。
lines.en: I hear chewing, and it is not mine.

lines.zh: 一条鱼盯上我了，我认得那眼神。
lines.en: A fish has fixed on me; I know that look.

lines.zh: 我亮了一下又灭掉，想引开它。
lines.en: I flash once and go dark, hoping to mislead it.

lines.zh: 我锁住那团晃动的影子，很小。
lines.en: I fix on the wobbling shadow; it is small.

lines.zh: 它在我的水域里，我不能不管。
lines.en: It is in my water, and I cannot ignore that.

lines.zh: 我挪到它背后，微光一点点加快。
lines.en: I creep behind it, my faint light quickening.

lines.zh: 我盯住它摆动的尾，那里最软。
lines.en: I fix on its flicking tail: the softest part.

lines.zh: 我鼓起来，引线在响。
lines.en: I swell up — the fuse is hissing.

lines.zh: 它靠近了，我体内的气开始聚。
lines.en: It comes closer, and the gas inside me gathers.

lines.zh: 我贴着礁石跟它，尽量不出声。
lines.en: I follow it along the reef, making no sound.

lines.zh: 我把它逼向珊瑚墙，那边没退路。
lines.en: I herd it toward the coral wall, where there is no way out.

lines.zh: 我藏在沙里，只露两根触须。
lines.en: I hide in the sand with only two tentacles showing.

lines.zh: 它每次转身，我都先停住。
lines.en: Each time it turns, I have already stopped.

lines.zh: 我算着距离，还差一个身位。
lines.en: I measure the gap: one body length to go.

lines.zh: 我的光调到最暗，自己都看不清。
lines.en: I dim until even I cannot see myself.

lines.zh: 它停下来喘，我知道机会来了。
lines.en: It pauses to breathe, and I know my chance has come.

lines.zh: 我绕了一圈，把出口留给自己。
lines.en: I circle once, keeping the exit for myself.

lines.zh: 它没发现我，我比它想的更耐心。
lines.en: It has not found me; I am more patient than it thinks.

lines.zh: 再近一点，我就只能炸了。
lines.en: One step closer and I have only bursting left.

lines.zh: 我扑上去，力道小得像挠痒。
lines.en: I lunge, and it lands as soft as a tickle.

lines.zh: 我咬不住，只能拿触须抽它。
lines.en: I cannot bite, so I whip it with a tentacle.

lines.zh: 我撞在它鳃边，它甩了一下尾巴。
lines.en: I hit its gill, and its tail flicks once.

lines.zh: 这一点点毒，够它麻一会儿。
lines.en: This much sting will numb it for a while.

lines.zh: 我打完就躲，躲得比打得快。
lines.en: I hide faster than I strike.

lines.zh: 它比我大十倍，我还是冲了。
lines.en: It is ten times my size, and I charge anyway.

lines.zh: 我整个压上去，像贴了张湿纸。
lines.en: I press down whole, like a sheet of wet paper.

lines.zh: 这一下用掉我一半的力气。
lines.en: That one blow cost me half my strength.

lines.zh: 它退开了，我居然赢了。
lines.en: It backs off, and somehow I have won.

lines.zh: 我身上开始发烫，得赶紧走。
lines.en: I am getting hot inside; I must leave quickly.

lines.zh: 我从一枚卵里出来，小得看不清。
lines.en: I come out of an egg too small to see clearly.

lines.zh: 我掉在珊瑚上，弹了两下才停。
lines.en: I drop onto the coral and bounce twice before stopping.

lines.zh: 周围都是大的，我显得特别小。
lines.en: Everyone here is big, and I look especially small.

lines.zh: 我第一次张伞盖，只张开一点点。
lines.en: The first time I open my bell, it barely opens.

lines.zh: 水流把我冲进石缝，我就在这住下。
lines.en: The current sweeps me into a crack, so I settle here.

lines.zh: 我一出生就带着气，很少，够用。
lines.en: I am born with gas inside, little but enough.

lines.zh: 我抬头，光离得远，世界很大。
lines.en: I look up; the light is far and the world is wide.

lines.zh: 这片沙地太亮了，我得找阴影。
lines.en: This sand is too bright; I need to find shade.

lines.zh: 我听见很大的水母在附近呼吸。
lines.en: I hear a much larger jelly breathing nearby.

lines.zh: 我悄悄亮了一下，算是打招呼。
lines.en: I glow once, quietly, as a kind of greeting.

lines.zh: 火燎到我，我的边缘卷了起来。
lines.en: The flame catches me and my edges curl.

lines.zh: 我摔在石头上，弹起又落下。
lines.en: I hit stone, bounce up, and fall again.

lines.zh: 我在水里，却觉得透不过气。
lines.en: I am in water, and yet I cannot catch my breath.

lines.zh: 旁边的爆炸直接把我掀翻了。
lines.en: The blast beside me flips me right over.

lines.zh: 一支箭擦过我，留下焦边。
lines.en: An arrow grazes me and leaves a scorched edge.

lines.zh: 魔法把我的触须拧成一团。
lines.en: Magic twists my tentacles into a knot.

lines.zh: 我饿得连亮都亮不起来了。
lines.en: I am so hungry I cannot even glow.

lines.zh: 电顺着水过来，我抖成一团。
lines.en: The charge comes through the water and I shake apart.

lines.zh: 虚空太干，我的伞盖开始裂。
lines.en: The void is so dry my bell begins to crack.
